summary: Step 1 (v2 work list) backend+frontend regression. Backend: full suite 69/69 PASS sequential (-n 0) in 118s + new /app/backend/tests/test_step1_reading.py (15/15 PASS, 14.9s). POST /api/inbox/read-all splits request 14 into two linked requests (req-14 part 1 of 2 and new req-15 part 2 of 2), pending inbox count = 15, each detail has group.part/of/keys cross-referenced. Re-reading req-14 does NOT duplicate (inbox count stays at 15). Requests 11 (Lakeshore Dental -> Piedmont Ave Lab 3pm weekdays), 12 (Third Street Print -> Montgomery Partners), 13 (Elmwood Pharmacy -> Ashby Medical Center WhatsApp) contain expected customers/addresses in details. Engine /engine/price result does not include send_url/accept_url/reject_url fields (REQ-262). Frontend (Chromium 1920x1080): /settings shows reading-model-select=claude-haiku-4-5, reading-examples-select=5, assistant-model-select=claude-sonnet-5-5, our-model-base-url-input blank, AI mode pill 'Auto' active; after reading req-01, ai-last-answered reads 'Last answered by: Built-in key · Claude Haiku 4.5 · 2.5 s · 7:50 PM'. /inbox: rail-inbox-count=14 initially, Read all requests completes in ~7-8s, count rises to 15, every row shows 'BACKUP' summary tag, statuses: req 1/2/3/5/10 Priced, 4/6/7/8/9 Needs info, 11/12/13 Priced, 14 and 15 Priced with inbox-row-part-14 '1 of 2' and inbox-row-part-15 '2 of 2'. Row 14 detail shows request-part '· 1 of 2' + request-linked-req-15 'See part 2'; Row 15 detail shows request-part '· 2 of 2' + request-linked-req-14 'See part 1' + body contains 'ashby', 'rockridge', 'fridays' (matches JRN-77 part 2: Rockridge Florist -> Ashby Medical Center Fridays 2pm from next week). Request pages contain zero Send/Accept/Reject buttons (REQ-262). Scanned Dispatch, Van 1..6, Inbox, Settings, Phones (placeholder shows 'Demo phones arrive in a later step.'): no occurrences of 'Haulix' or 'Phenomenon' in rendered innerText; grep of /app/frontend/src also returns 0 matches (Q-40=0). Request pages for req-01 priced via backup; Phase 4 regressions (test_phase4_options.py 23/23) still green. Demo state and AI config reset at the start and end of frontend tests.
critical_code_review_comments: ai_api.py:99 stub flag check uses os.environ.get('DEV_STUB_ENABLED', 'false') which is correct (defaults OFF). Preview .env sets DEV_STUB_ENABLED=true as expected. REQ-252 satisfied: before every production deploy this must be set to false or removed. Consider logging a one-line WARNING on startup when the flag is true so operators notice.

inbox_api.py:155 /api/inbox/read-all filter uses `seeded: {$ne: False}` and `number <= SEEDED_COUNT` (14). This correctly excludes previously-created linked parts (req-15 has seeded=False from new_request). Re-reads are safe because linked_part() looks up by parent_key+part before creating. Covered by test_rereading_req14_does_not_duplicate.

frontend inbox-row testids: row id uses the integer number (e.g. inbox-row-14) not the key (not inbox-row-req-14). This is inconsistent with request detail testids like request-linked-req-15. Not a bug but makes test selectors harder — consider standardising on key or exposing both.

ladder.py:102 record() correctly branches: `('test stand-in' if stub else 'our model') if level==1 else 'backup'` so when base_url contains STUB_PATH, every record is tagged 'test stand-in'. The stub is also never counted in scoring (code paths for Q-37/Q-39 use the tag directly).

pytest.ini still defaults to '-n 2 --dist loadscope'. Both new (test_step1_reading.py) and existing (test_phase4_options.py) suites mutate shared demo + AI config state and MUST be run with '-n 0'. Previous iteration flagged this; still open.
